menu.restartNotManaged: The panel doesn't run as a Swarm service here.
menu.needsHostAdmin: Needs server access, which only the owner gives.

panelDomain.title: Panel domain
panelDomain.hint: Must point at this server. Anyone on the server can still reach the panel on localhost.
panelDomain.serveOnIpHint: Off, only the domains above answer.

serviceDomain.title: Service domain
serviceDomain.description: The domain new services get a hostname under.
serviceDomain.hint: New services are published as project-service under this domain.
serviceDomain.dns: This needs a wildcard DNS record, *.your-domain.com, pointing at this server.

letsEncrypt.title: Let's Encrypt
letsEncrypt.description: Who certificate authorities contact. Applied at the next proxy restart.
letsEncrypt.emailHint: Let's Encrypt warns this address before a certificate expires.

console.title: Server console
console.refused: The console could not be opened.

docker.tooOld: This engine is older than the tested minimum, {{minimum}}.
docker.swarmInactive: Swarm isn't active on this Docker engine.
docker.warnUnavailable: Docker isn't answering. What depends on it is out of date.
docker.missingIntro: This Docker can't do what the panel needs, so anything that would use it is refused:

missing.version: Docker {{version}} is older than {{minimum}}, the oldest version tested with this panel.
missing.api: Docker's Engine API is {{apiVersion}}, and the panel needs {{minimumApi}} or later.
missing.swarm: Swarm isn't active and managed from this node.
missing.overlay: Docker has no overlay network driver.
missing.volumes: Docker has no local volume driver.
missing.buildx: The Docker CLI's buildx plugin doesn't work with this Docker, so builds are refused.
missing.compose: The Docker CLI's Compose plugin doesn't answer, so Compose stacks are refused.

docker.upgradeHint: Upgrading the engine is up to you: the panel never changes the host's Docker.

cleanup.summary: {{size}} to reclaim. Kept because in use or still needed: {{retained}}. Not created by the panel, left alone: {{foreign}}.

images.title: Clean images
images.description: Images the panel built or a past service used, that nothing runs anymore. The image of any service that still exists stays, even when it is stopped.

builder.title: Clean builder cache
builder.description: Build cache the panel's own builds created and nothing is using. Cache from anyone else's builds stays.

system.title: System prune
system.description: Unused images and build cache of the panel's own, stopped containers of its services and leftover project networks. Volumes are never touched.

cleanup.typeHint: Nothing is removed without this word.

proxy.savedEnv: Saved. It applies at the next restart.
proxy.trustAllHint: Only for a proxy that nothing else can reach directly.
proxy.restartNote: Saving restarts Traefik briefly. The panel keeps running.
proxy.customDescription: YAML for Traefik's file provider. Invalid YAML is refused.
proxy.envDescription: NAME=value, one per line. Applied at the next restart.
proxy.dashboardDescription: Publishes the dashboard on a generated host, behind a password.
proxy.dashboardOnce: Shown once, and replaced at each proxy restart.
proxy.dashboardUserHint: Sign in to the dashboard with this.

confirm.panelDescription: The panel goes away for a few seconds. What it runs keeps running.
confirm.proxyDescription: Every site is unreachable for a few seconds, and the dashboard password changes.
confirm.rebootDescription: Everything running on it stops until the machine is back.

dailyCleanupHint: Off until you turn it on. Once a day it removes only what the cleanups in the Docker menu would offer, and never a volume.
releasesKeptHint: How many of the newest versions of each service stay on this server for going back to. Each one keeps its image on the disk. Lowering this removes the older ones right away.
